final_topology.title: Government Isolated Network
final_topology.description: A network for government operations with isolated sensitive systems and secure management workstations.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network will consist of separate zones for standard and sensitive information, with dedicated management workstations and a secure internet gateway for the standard environment.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating the presence of an asset management system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating the presence of a data flow documentation system.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1), 'Sensitive Environment' (z2), and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n_struct4) in various zones, indicating the implementation of firewalls on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) and a 'DNS Filtering Server' (n10) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating the requirement for MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Server' (n10) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n11) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones, firewalls, routers, and security systems, indicating a well-designed and maintained secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management System' (n_new4) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating the use of version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n12) connected to various nodes and zones, indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Workstations' zone (z3) with dedicated workstations (n3, n4) and a 'Management Router' (n8), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative tasks.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS Sensor' (n13) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6) and 'SIEM' (n17), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n_struct4) and routers (n6, n7, n8) that manage traffic between different zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) and a 'Remote Device Manager' (n_new5) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Logger' (n_new6) connected to the 'SIEM' (n17), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS Sensor' (n14) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6) and 'SIEM' (n17), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n16) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n15) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1) and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Penetration Testing Zone' (z6) and a 'Pentest Workstation' (n18) connected to the 'Secure Gateway' (n5), indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z4 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z5 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes labeled links indicating data flows, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Central AAA Server (n12), but there is no explicit evidence of MFA being required for remote access.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of MFA requirement for remote access.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a label or node indicating MFA is required for remote access.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes or labels indicating secure management practices like IaC or secure protocols.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Secure Gateway (n5) and a Central AAA Server (n12), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Secure Gateway (n5) and a Central AAA Server (n12), but there is no explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating access control for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n17) connected to various nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of collecting network traffic flow logs.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating network traffic flow log collection.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Penetration Testing Zone (z6) and a Pentest Workstation (n18), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating periodic external penetration tests.
